title: precheck names an item check that empties a planted file before it reads it
goal: backlog.py check and precheck name an item check whose python code opens a file for writing in the same statement that reads it (open(p, 'w').write(open(p).read()...)), through a bl_check.planted_input_problem predicate, so a check that cannot pass is fixed before the start gate and not found by the worker (SP-46k7sw57: ST-smr7z3vn's check 0 emptied kb/team-b/_root.md and appended to a file its planted root lacked; precheck showed it failing on its premise assertion)

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_check
f = getattr(bl_check, "planted_input_problem", None)
if f is None:
    print("check failed: bl_check has no planted_input_problem predicate"); sys.exit(1)
bad = ["python3", "-c", 'p = "x"; open(p, "w").write(open(p).read().replace("a", "b"))']
good = ["python3", "-c", 'p = "x"; t = open(p).read(); open(p, "w").write(t.replace("a", "b"))']
if not f(bad) or f(good):
    print("check failed: planted_input_problem does not name a check that empties a planted file before reading it", f(bad), f(good)); sys.exit(1)
